name: Granola
tagline: AI notepad that turns your meeting notes into great notes
description: Granola is a meeting notepad designed for back-to-back call days. Instead of joining as a bot, it transcribes locally on macOS and rewrites your rough notes into structured, shareable summaries. Templates support sales calls, 1:1s, customer interviews, and standups, and outputs sync to Notion, Linear, Slack, and CRMs.
pricingDetails: Free: 25 meetings. Individual: $18/month. Business: $25/user/month. Enterprise: custom.
